records.generatedCopy: GitHub Copilot code review can now resolve addressed comments during re-review, but a closed thread is not proof that a fix works or a pull request is ready to merge. This guide adds a two-ledger model and six canaries that bind conversation state and deterministic validation to the current head SHA. Use it to reduce review noise without weakening CI, approvals, or repository rules.

Copilot can close addressed review threads during re-review. That still does not prove the fix passed on the current head SHA. Use this six-case gate before merging.
